_note: The server charges these prices, never the browser's. Prices are in fils (389000 = KWD 389.000). null = not for sale online yet. Keep them equal to the prices in the site's product list (P in parts/js1.js). "colors" lists the colours a product comes in; each order line must then name one, and a colour with "soldOut": true cannot be ordered. "img" and "brand" are only used for the search-engine product listing.
